The programme provides funding for a whole postgraduate or Master's degree programme at a state or state-recognised university in Germany, or one year of study in Germany as part of a Master's degree completed at a home university.

scholarships.title: Study Visits for Academics - Artists and Architects

scholarships.title: Study Scholarships - Master Studies for All Academic Disciplines
scholarships.description: DAAD scholarships for graduates with a first academic degree wishing to continue their academic training in Germany with a postgraduate course of study.

scholarships.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
scholarships.description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters are prestigious international masters, jointly designed and delivered by a group of higher education institutions. scholarships.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters

scholarships.description: Chevening Scholarships enable outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world to pursue one-year master’s degrees in the UK. scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarship
scholarships.description: Chevening Scholarships are the UK government’s global scholarship programme, funded by the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) and partner organisations. The programme offers the opportunity to study in the UK to build knowledge, skills, and networks.

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarship
scholarships.description: Chevening Scholarships allow exceptional individuals to study for a one-year master’s degree at any UK university. The programme is aimed at emerging leaders who demonstrate ambition, leadership qualities, and a passion for influencing positive change.

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarship

scholarships.description: Chevening Scholarships are the UK government’s global scholarship programme, funded by the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) and partner organisations. The awards offer support for individuals to study at UK universities.

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) and partner organisations
scholarships.description: Chevening Scholarships are UK government-funded awards for students to pursue full-time taught master's degrees in the UK. Applicants must select three eligible master's courses at UK universities.

scholarships.title: Chevening Fellowships
scholarships.description: Chevening Fellowships are offered to mid-career professionals who have reached a position of influence and want to increase their knowledge, networks, and potential through tailored short courses, research, or professional placements at UK institutions.

scholarships.title: Chevening Oxford Centre for Islamic Studies Fellowships (OCIS)
scholarships.description: These fellowships enable mid-career academics or professionals to undertake a period of self-directed research focusing on the culture and civilisation of Islam and contemporary Muslim societies in a global context. Fellows will benefit from meeting a multi-disciplinary group of scholars focusing on the Islamic world.

scholarships.title: Chevening Fellowships
scholarships.description: Chevening Fellowships are aimed at mid-career professionals who have reached a position of influence and want to increase their knowledge, networks, and potential through tailored short courses, research, or professional placements at UK institutions.

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarship

scholarships.title: Chevening SIDS Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Chevening SIDS Scholarship is an opportunity for outstanding individuals from Small Island Developing States (SIDS) to pursue a one-year master’s degree in the UK. scholarships.title: Chevening SIDS Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Chevening / Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO)
scholarships.description: The Chevening SIDS Scholarship is an opportunity for outstanding individuals from Small Island Developing States (SIDS) to pursue a one-year master’s degree in the UK. scholarships.title: Chevening ASEAN Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Chevening ASEAN Scholarship is an opportunity for outstanding individuals from ASEAN member states or Timor-Leste to pursue a one-year master’s degree in the UK. It includes all standard Chevening Scholarship benefits plus an enhanced UK programme featuring exclusive events, priority invitations to networking opportunities, and a post-graduation ASEAN Chevening Conference.

scholarships.title: Chevening ASEAN Scholarship
scholarships.description: The ASEAN Chevening Scholarship is an opportunity for outstanding individuals from ASEAN member states or Timor-Leste to pursue a one-year master’s degree in the UK.

scholarships.title: Commonwealth Master’s Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
scholarships.description: Commonwealth Master’s Scholarships are for candidates from eligible lower and upper middle income Commonwealth countries, to undertake full-time taught Master’s study at a UK university. Funded by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO).

scholarships.title: Master’s Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
scholarships.description: Master’s Scholarships enable talented and motivated individuals to gain the knowledge and skills required for sustainable development. Candidates are nominated for this award through a nominating agency.

scholarships.title: CSC Research Impact Awards
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
scholarships.description: The CSC Research Impact Awards celebrate the research and publication endeavours of Commonwealth Scholars and Alumni at the early and mid-career researcher stages. The awards are offered through two streams: the CSC Research Output award stream, which offers a conference grant, and the Taylor & Francis CSC Research Implementation and Uptake award stream, which offers a prize of £1,500 and a journal subscription or e-book.

scholarships.title: Commonwealth Professional Fellowships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
scholarships.description: Commonwealth Professional Fellowships are for mid-career professionals from low and middle income countries to spend a period of time at a UK host organisation working in their sector for a programme of professional development.

scholarships.description: Commonwealth Scholarships and Fellowships provide talented and motivated individuals with the opportunity to enhance knowledge and skills in their given sector, in order to contribute to sustainable development in their home countries.

scholarships.title: Commonwealth Fellowships

fields: Improving population health, health systems and capacity
Strengthening resilience and response to crises
scholarships.description: The Commonwealth Fellowship Programme consists of Professional Fellowships for mid-career professionals and Academic Fellowships for academic staff holding a PhD to undertake professional development or research at UK host organisations.

scholarships.title: Commonwealth Startup Fellowships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC) and Imperial College London
scholarships.description: The Commonwealth Startup Fellowships is a six-month programme designed to elevate high-potential startups from low and middle income Commonwealth countries. scholarships.title: Commonwealth Professional Fellowships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)
fields: Improving population health, health systems and capacity
Strengthening resilience and response to crises
scholarships.description: Commonwealth Professional Fellowships provide mid-career professionals from eligible Commonwealth countries the opportunity to undertake a programme of professional development at a UK host organisation. The programme aims to provide a developmental impact upon the Fellow's return home and covers return airfare, visa fees, a monthly stipend, and an arrival allowance.

scholarships.title: Commonwealth PhD Scholarships for Least Developed Countries and Vulnerable States
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)
scholarships.description: Commonwealth PhD Scholarships are for applicants from least developed countries and vulnerable states for full-time doctoral study at a UK university, contributing to the development needs of Commonwealth countries by supporting research that will have a developmental impact.

scholarships.title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)
scholarships.description: The Commonwealth Shared Scholarship programme provides opportunities for students from Least Developed and middle-income Commonwealth countries to undertake a Master's degree at participating UK universities. scholarships.title: Commonwealth Master’s Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)
scholarships.description: Commonwealth Master’s Scholarships are for candidates from eligible low and middle income Commonwealth countries to undertake full-time taught Master’s study at a UK university. scholarships.title: Rhodes Scholarship

scholarships.title: Rhodes Scholarship

It is a merit-based scholarship that values academic excellence, energy to use one's talents to the full, truth, courage, devotion to duty, and moral force of character.

scholarships.title: Rhodes Scholarship

scholarships.title: Rhodes Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Swedish Institute (SI) offers fully funded scholarships for master's level studies in Sweden. The program includes 'Global Professionals' for those aiming to advance sustainable growth and societal change, and 'Pioneering Women in STEM' to empower women in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics. Scholarship holders join the SI Network for Global Professionals (NFGP).

scholarships.title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
scholarships.description: A fully funded scholarship for professionals who want to advance sustainable growth and drive societal change in their home country.

scholarships.title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
scholarships.description: The SI Scholarship for Global Professionals is awarded to international students for master's programmes within STEM, innovation and entrepreneurship, public health, and governance at Swedish universities.

scholarships.title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
scholarships.description: The SI Scholarship for Global Professionals offers fully-funded academic scholarships for master’s studies in Sweden for professionals with work and leadership experience who have the ambition to contribute to change in their home country and region.

scholarships.title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
scholarships.description: The SI Scholarship for Global Professionals is a fully-funded academic scholarship for master's studies in Sweden, covering both tuition fees and living costs.

scholarships.title: Pioneering Women in STEM
scholarships.description: The Pioneering Women in STEM scholarship supports women from selected countries in Africa and Asia who want to lead innovation and drive societal change through master's studies in STEM fields in Sweden. The scholarship is fully funded, covering tuition fees, a monthly living allowance of SEK 12,000, and a one-time travel grant of SEK 15,000.

scholarships.title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
scholarships.description: The SI Scholarship for Global Professionals is a fully-funded scholarship for master’s studies in Sweden. It covers tuition fees, living expenses (SEK 12,000 per month), and a travel grant. It aims to support professionals who will contribute to the sustainable development of their home countries.

scholarships.title: France Excellence Eiffel
scholarships.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
scholarships.description: The France Excellence Eiffel scholarship program is a tool developed by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs to enable French higher education institutions to attract top foreign students for master's and doctoral level studies.

scholarships.title: France Excellence Eiffel scholarship program
scholarships.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
scholarships.description: The Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Program was established by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs to enable French higher education institutions to attract top foreign students to enroll in their masters and PhD programs. scholarships.title: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
scholarships.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
scholarships.description: A prestigious scholarship program for foreign students selected by French institutions to pursue Master's or Doctoral studies in France. The program provides a monthly living allowance, coverage for certain travel expenses, health insurance, and assistance with housing.

scholarships.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs and French Ministry for Higher Education and Research
fields: Human, animal and ecosystem health (One Health approach)
scholarships.description: The Make Our Planet Great Again (MOPGA) visiting fellowship program supports early career researchers (holding a doctoral degree for less than 5 years) to carry out research in France on topics related to climate change and environmental issues. The fellowship includes a monthly allowance of 2,500 euros, a moving allowance, and health insurance.

scholarships.title: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship (GOI-IES)
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship (GOI-IES) programme provides 60 scholarships annually to high-calibre international students for one year of full-time study at master's, postgraduate diploma, or PhD level in Ireland. The award includes a €10,000 stipend and a full fee waiver from the host institution.

scholarships.title: SUSI (Student Universal Support Ireland) Grants
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: SUSI (Student Universal Support Ireland) is Ireland’s single national awarding authority for all higher and further education grants. Support is available to eligible students in approved full-time third-level education in Ireland and also, in some cases, funding for students studying outside of Ireland.

scholarships.title: Fund for Students with Disabilities (FSD)
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Fund for Students with Disabilities (FSD) assists higher education institutions in ensuring students with disabilities have the necessary assistance and equipment to enable them to access, fully participate in, and successfully complete their chosen course of study. Funding is allocated to the college to provide supports such as assistive technology, non-medical helpers, academic support, and transport, rather than directly to the student.

scholarships.title: Student Assistance Fund
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Student Assistance Fund provides financial support to full or part-time students who are experiencing financial difficulties while attending college. It is designed to provide a source of financial support in addition to a SUSI grant to help with costs such as books, class materials, rent, utility bills, food, travel, childcare, and medical costs.

scholarships.title: Back to Education Allowance
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Back to Education Allowance (BTEA) allows people who are unemployed, parenting alone, or have a disability and are receiving certain payments from the Department of Social Protection to take part in second- or third-level education courses while continuing to receive support.

scholarships.title: Free Fees Initiative
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Free Fees Initiative provides funding for tuition fees for eligible full-time undergraduate students undertaking approved courses in participating higher education institutions in Ireland. Students must meet specific nationality and residency requirements (ordinarily resident in an EU/EEA/Swiss State/UK for at least three of the five years preceding entry). Note that eligible students are still required to pay a student contribution charge.

scholarships.title: Postgraduate student funding (SUSI)
scholarships.provider: Higher Education Authority / SUSI (Student Universal Support Ireland)
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: SUSI (Student Universal Support Ireland) funding is available for students to pursue postgraduate courses in approved institutions. The page also references tax relief available on postgraduate tuition fees.

scholarships.description: The Foreign Language Teaching Assistant (FLTA) Program allows educators to teach their native language, connect with their host community, and share their culture while strengthening their English language skills and extending their knowledge of the societies and cultures of the United States.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme

scholarships.title: Vocational Short Term Training Scholarships
scholarships.description: The New Zealand Government offers Vocational Short Term Training Scholarships to fund skills training and work experience for professionals from eligible countries to learn new skills that contribute to their country's social and economic development.

scholarships.title: English Language Training for Officials Scholarships (NZELTO)

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme
scholarships.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme provides funding for citizens from eligible countries in the Pacific and Asia to study at tertiary education institutes in New Zealand or the Pacific.

scholarships.title: Samoa Foundation

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships are awarded to citizens from eligible developing countries to undertake study in New Zealand or the Pacific. The scholarship is designed to enable scholars to contribute to their country's social and economic development. Eligibility requires applicants to be 18 years old, reside in their home country for at least two years prior to applying, and possess relevant work experience for postgraduate study.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships provide opportunities for international students from eligible countries to undertake undergraduate and postgraduate study in New Zealand. The selection process is highly competitive and involves screening, psychometric testing, assessment of academic and work experience, and online video interviews. Scholars are expected to return to their home countries for at least two years after completing their studies to contribute to social and economic development.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships provide funding for students from eligible regions and countries to study in New Zealand. Applicants are encouraged to select subjects based on the social and economic needs of their home country.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship provides funding for international students from eligible countries to undertake undergraduate or postgraduate study in New Zealand. scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships

The scholarships are available to citizens from eligible regions and countries, with a focus on subjects aligned with the social and economic needs of the applicant's country.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship provides funding for international students to study in New Zealand.
